shortDescription: NetApp E-Series manage global settings configuration

options.name: api_password
options.description: The password to authenticate with the SANtricity Web Services Proxy or Embedded Web Services API.

options.name: api_url
options.description: The url to the SANtricity Web Services Proxy or Embedded Web Services API. Example https://prod-1.wahoo.acme.com:8443/devmgr/v2

options.name: api_username
options.description: The username to authenticate with the SANtricity Web Services Proxy or Embedded Web Services API.

options.name: automatic_load_balancing
options.description: Enable automatic load balancing to allow incoming traffic from the hosts to be dynamically managed and balanced across both controllers. Automatic load balancing requires host connectivity reporting to be enabled.

options.name: cache_block_size
options.description: Size of the cache's block size. All volumes on the storage system share the same cache space; therefore, the volumes can have only one cache block size. See M(netapp_eseries.santricity.na_santricity_facts) for available sizes.

options.name: cache_flush_threshold
options.description: This is the percentage threshold of the amount of unwritten data that is allowed to remain on the storage array's cache before flushing.

options.name: controller_shelf_id
options.description: This is the identifier for the drive enclosure containing the controllers.

options.name: default_host_type
options.description: Default host type for the storage system. Either one of the following names can be specified, Linux DM-MP, VMWare, Windows, Windows Clustered, or a host type index which can be found in M(netapp_eseries.santricity.na_santricity_facts)

options.name: host_connectivity_reporting
options.description: Enable host connectivity reporting to allow host connections to be monitored for connection and multipath driver problems. When I(automatic_load_balancing==enabled) then M(netapp_eseries.santricity.host_connectivity_reporting) must be enabled.

options.name: login_banner_message
options.description: Text message that appears prior to the login page. I(login_banner_message=="") will delete any existing banner message.

options.name: name
options.description: Set the name of the E-Series storage-system This label/name doesn't have to be unique. May be up to 30 characters in length.

options.name: ssid
options.description: The ID of the array to manage. This value must be unique for each array.
